hook.name: KingOfTheHillHook
hook.description: A competitive "King of the Hill" hook where the largest single ETH buyer becomes king and earns 2% fees from all buys. Kings are dethroned when a new buyer exceeds a decaying threshold (×1.03); dethroned kings receive NFT commemorations (ChronicleSoul/ChronicleScroll) and have 12 hours to claim earnings before a keeper can forfeit and buyback-burn the remaining KOTH.
